question: Find the product of the greatest among the numbers 0.82, 0.802, 0.85, 0.085 with the smallest among the numbers 0.3, 0.03, 0.203, 2.03
solution:
Given:

Given set of numbers:

0.82, 0.802, 0.85, 0.085

0.3, 0.03, 0.203, 2.03

Calculation:

Hence,

The greatest among the numbers 0.82, 0.802, 0.85, 0.085 = 0.85

The smallest among the numbers 0.3, 0.03, 0.203, 2.03 = 0.03

Thus, their product = 0.85 × 0.03 = 0.0255

**∴ The product of the greatest among the numbers 0.82, 0.802, 0.85, 0.085 with the smallest among the numbers 0.3, 0.03, 0.203, 2.03 is 0.0255.**
